sections.instruction: Choose the correct answer from a, b, c or d:

items.question: We ................ souvenirs from Khan El Khalili.
items.explanation_ar: بنشتري buy الهدايا التذكارية من خان الخليلي.
items.explanation_en: We buy souvenirs from Khan El Khalili.

items.question: Tourists come to Egypt to ................ the ancient sites.
items.explanation_ar: السياح بييجوا مصر علشان visit يعني يزوروا الآثار القديمة.
items.explanation_en: Tourists come to Egypt to visit the ancient sites.

items.question: Carpenters ................ furniture in Damietta.
items.explanation_ar: النجارين make يعني بيصنعوا الأثاث في دمياط.
items.explanation_en: Carpenters make furniture in Damietta.

items.question: They spend a great day ................ Aswan.
items.explanation_ar: مع اسم المدينة بنستخدم in: in Aswan.
items.explanation_en: We use in with the name of a city: in Aswan.

items.question: His family learns many new things about the Egyptian ................
items.explanation_ar: العيلة بتتعلم حاجات جديدة عن Egyptian Museum يعني المتحف المصري.
items.explanation_en: The family learns new things at the Egyptian Museum.

items.question: We use colored ................ to make beautiful jewelry.
items.explanation_ar: بنستخدم colored stones يعني أحجار ملونة في عمل المجوهرات.
items.explanation_en: We use colored stones to make jewelry.

items.question: People described papyrus as a ................ that lasts long
items.explanation_ar: البردي writing material يعني خامة للكتابة وبتعيش كتير.
items.explanation_en: Papyrus is a writing material that lasts a long time.

items.question: Egypt builds big ................ to produce electricity from water.
items.explanation_ar: مصر بتبني dams يعني سدود علشان تنتج كهربا من الميه.
items.explanation_en: Egypt builds big dams to produce electricity from water.

items.question: We should use water ................ so we don't waste this important resource.
items.explanation_ar: علشان منضيعش الميه بنستخدمها wisely يعني بحكمة.
items.explanation_en: We should use water wisely so we do not waste it.

items.question: You must have a ................ to enter a different country.
items.grading_reason: السياق لا يحدد إجابة واحدة مؤكدة. يُراجع مع المدرس ولا يدخل في الدرجة.
items.explanation_ar: مفيش إجابة واحدة مؤكدة للسؤال ده، فراجعه مع المدرس.
items.explanation_en: This item has no single confirmed answer, so check it with your teacher.

items.question: Go to the ................ when you don't know where to go.
items.explanation_ar: لما منعرفش نروح فين بنروح information desk يعني مكتب الاستعلامات.
items.explanation_en: Go to the information desk when you do not know where to go.

items.question: The tourist phoned the hotel to ................ a room.
items.explanation_ar: السائح اتصل بالفندق علشان book يعني يحجز أوضة.
items.explanation_en: The tourist phoned the hotel to book a room.

items.question: To ................ the plane you should have a ticket.
items.explanation_ar: board the plane يعني تركب الطيارة، ولازم يبقى معاك تذكرة.
items.explanation_en: To board the plane you need a ticket.

items.question: Tourists can take a ................ to learn more about the museum.
items.explanation_ar: guided tour يعني جولة مع مرشد بتعرّفنا أكتر عن المتحف.
items.explanation_en: A guided tour teaches us more about the museum.

items.question: I can climb the high ................
items.explanation_ar: بنتسلق الـ mountain يعني الجبل العالي.
items.explanation_en: You climb a high mountain.

items.question: ................ are a kind of animals.
items.explanation_ar: Kangaroos يعني الكنغر نوع من الحيوانات. الباقي مش حيوانات.
items.explanation_en: Kangaroos are a kind of animal. The other words are not animals.

items.question: I like to ................ photos with my phone.
items.explanation_ar: بنقول take photos يعني نصوّر.
items.explanation_en: The collocation is take photos.

items.question: I ................ fresh food.
items.explanation_ar: I فاعل، فنستخدم الفعل المصدر like من غير s.
items.explanation_en: With I we use the base verb like, with no s.

items.question: What are you ................?
items.explanation_ar: are you + فعل-ing للحاضر المستمر: doing.
items.explanation_en: Are you + verb-ing is the present continuous: doing.

items.question: Let's ................ the rubbish out.
items.explanation_ar: take the rubbish out معناها نخرّج الزبالة.
items.explanation_en: Take the rubbish out means to carry it outside.

items.question: He ................ rice very much.
items.explanation_ar: He فاعل مفرد، فنزود s: likes.
items.explanation_en: He is singular, so the verb takes s: likes.

items.question: What are you ................ now?
items.explanation_ar: now بتدل على حاجة بتحصل دلوقتي، فنستخدم drawing.
items.explanation_en: Now shows something happening at this moment, so we use drawing.

items.question: We ................ football every day.
items.explanation_ar: every day بتدل على عادة، وWe جمع، فنستخدم play من غير s.
items.explanation_en: Every day shows a habit and We is plural, so we use play with no s.

items.question: It ................ snows in summer in Egypt.
items.explanation_ar: في مصر مفيش تلج في الصيف: never.
items.explanation_en: It never snows in summer in Egypt.

items.question: When it's hot, people drink water and rest in the ................
items.explanation_ar: لما الجو يبقى حر الناس بترتاح في الضل: shade.
items.explanation_en: When it is hot people rest in the shade.

items.question: I like looking at the high ................ in the sea.
items.explanation_ar: بنبص على waves يعني الموج العالي في البحر.
items.explanation_en: I like looking at the high waves in the sea.

items.question: It is windy and the sky is full of dark ................
items.explanation_ar: السما مليانة dark clouds يعني غيوم داكنة لما الجو يبقى عاصف.
items.explanation_en: The sky is full of dark clouds when it is windy.

items.question: In ................ weather, people should drink a lot of water.
items.explanation_ar: في hot weather يعني الجو الحر لازم نشرب ميه كتير.
items.explanation_en: In hot weather people should drink a lot of water.

items.question: The streets are ................ because it is raining heavily.
items.explanation_ar: لما المطر يبقى جامد الشوارع بتبقى wet يعني مبلولة.
items.explanation_en: When it rains heavily the streets are wet.

items.question: We wear hats to ................ ourselves from the sun.
items.explanation_ar: بنلبس القبعات علشان نحمي نفسنا من الشمس: protect.
items.explanation_en: We wear hats to protect ourselves from the sun.

items.question: What are you ................, Nada?
items.explanation_ar: What are you + فعل-ing: doing.
items.explanation_en: What are you + verb-ing is the present continuous: doing.

items.question: I'm ................ for the football game.
items.explanation_ar: I'm + فعل-ing للحاضر المستمر: practicing.
items.explanation_en: I'm + verb-ing is the present continuous: practicing.

items.question: I went to the ................ to send a letter.
items.explanation_ar: بنبعت الجواب من post office يعني مكتب البريد.
items.explanation_en: You send a letter at the post office.

items.question: Clean the room by ................, Ali.
items.explanation_ar: الأمر موجّه لـ Ali (you)، فنستخدم yourself.
items.explanation_en: The command is to Ali (you), so we use yourself.

items.question: My favorite ................ is football.
items.explanation_ar: football رياضة، فالإجابة sport.
items.explanation_en: Football is a sport.

items.question: I am ................ in watching films.
items.explanation_ar: I am interested in بتعبر عن إحساس الشخص، فنستخدم interested.
items.explanation_en: I am interested in describes how a person feels, so we use interested.

items.question: A paramedic helps people in an ................
items.explanation_ar: المسعف بيساعد الناس في emergency يعني حالة طوارئ.
items.explanation_en: A paramedic helps people in an emergency.

items.question: A mechanic fixes ................
items.explanation_ar: الميكانيكي بيصلّح vehicles يعني المركبات.
items.explanation_en: A mechanic fixes vehicles.

items.question: A traffic officer helps people ................ the road.
items.explanation_ar: ضابط المرور بيساعد الناس cross the road يعني يعدّوا الشارع.
items.explanation_en: A traffic officer helps people cross the road.

items.question: We use "can" to talk about ................
items.explanation_ar: بنستخدم can علشان نتكلم عن ability يعني القدرة.
items.explanation_en: We use can to talk about ability.

items.question: She is ................ to speak English well.
items.explanation_ar: بنقول be able to + فعل: She is able to speak.
items.explanation_en: We say be able to + verb: She is able to speak.

items.question: You should turn ................ lights and the computer when you finish using them.
items.explanation_ar: turn off يعني نطفي النور والكمبيوتر.
items.explanation_en: Turn off means to switch off the lights and the computer.

items.question: You ................ speak politely to your parents.
items.explanation_ar: must معناها لازم، والجملة قاعدة أدب مع الأهل.
items.explanation_en: Must shows an obligation, and speaking politely to parents is a rule.

items.question: Don't ................ water when you have a bath.
items.explanation_ar: Don't waste water معناها ماتضيّعش الميه وإنت بتاخد حمام.
items.explanation_en: Don't waste water means do not use more than you need.

items.question: Tourists like to come to Egypt to ................ the ancient sites.
items.explanation_ar: بنزور visit الآثار القديمة.
items.explanation_en: We visit the ancient sites.

items.question: Asmaa ................ us every week.
items.explanation_ar: every week بتدل على عادة، وAsmaa مفرد، فنستخدم visits.
items.explanation_en: Every week shows a habit and Asmaa is singular, so we use visits.

items.question: Every morning, Ahmed ................ a cup of tea.
items.explanation_ar: Every morning بتدل على عادة، وAhmed مفرد، فنستخدم drinks.
items.explanation_en: Every morning shows a habit and Ahmed is singular, so we use drinks.

items.question: What time ................ you leave for school every day?
items.explanation_ar: مع you بنستخدم do في المضارع البسيط.
items.explanation_en: With you we use do in the present simple.

items.question: Egypt has many valuable treasures ................ the ground.
items.explanation_ar: الكنوز تحت الأرض: under the ground.
items.explanation_en: The treasures are under the ground.

items.question: We must ................ our planet from pollution.
items.explanation_ar: لازم نحمي كوكبنا من التلوث: protect.
items.explanation_en: We must protect our planet from pollution.

items.question: Gases from cars, buses and factories can ................ the air.
items.explanation_ar: الغازات من العربيات والمصانع ممكن تلوّث الهوا: pollute.
items.explanation_en: Gases from cars and factories can pollute the air.

items.question: The word ................ means worried.
items.explanation_ar: nervous معناها قلقان.
items.explanation_en: Nervous means worried.

items.question: Jana is very ................ . She always helps people.
items.explanation_ar: Jana دايما بتساعد الناس، يعني helpful.
items.explanation_en: Jana always helps people, so she is helpful.

items.question: Amr is ................ . He shows respect to everyone.
items.explanation_ar: Amr بيحترم الكل، يعني polite أي مؤدب.
items.explanation_en: Amr shows respect to everyone, so he is polite.

items.question: Hana is ................ . She's worried about talking to people.
items.explanation_ar: Hana قلقانة من الكلام مع الناس، يعني shy أي خجولة.
items.explanation_en: Hana is worried about talking to people, so she is shy.

items.question: The roof is the ................ of the building.
items.explanation_ar: السقف roof هو top يعني أعلى المبنى.
items.explanation_en: The roof is the top of the building.

items.question: We go to the club ................ night
items.explanation_ar: مع night بنقول at night.
items.explanation_en: We say at night.

items.question: He is ................ best friend.
items.explanation_ar: قبل best friend بنستخدم صفة الملكية my.
items.explanation_en: Before best friend we use the possessive adjective my.

items.question: Noor, Ahmed, and Farida were always looking for ways to ................
items.explanation_ar: في القصة الأصحاب كانوا دايما بيدوّروا على طرق علشان help يعني يساعدوا.
items.explanation_en: In the story the friends were always looking for ways to help.

items.question: The tap in the school bathroom kept ................ even when no one used it.
items.explanation_ar: الحنفية كانت dripping يعني بتنقّط حتى لما محدش بيستخدمها.
items.explanation_en: The tap kept dripping even when no one used it.

items.question: Water overflowed from a broken ................ in the garden.
items.explanation_ar: الميه بتفيض من pipe يعني ماسورة مكسورة في الجنينة.
items.explanation_en: Water overflowed from a broken pipe in the garden.

items.question: Noor thought the water drops were too ................ to waste.
items.explanation_ar: Noor شافت إن نقط الميه precious يعني ثمينة جدا ومينفعش تتضيّع.
items.explanation_en: Noor thought water drops were too precious to waste.

items.question: Farida wanted them to be ................
items.explanation_ar: Farida عايزاهم يبقوا Water Savers يعني موفّري الميه.
items.explanation_en: Farida wanted them to be Water Savers.

items.question: The three friends walked around the school with ................
options: a notebook, a camera, and curious eyes
items.answer: a notebook, a camera, and curious eyes
items.explanation_ar: الأصحاب مشيوا في المدرسة بـ notebook وcamera وعيون فضولية.
items.explanation_en: The friends walked around the school with a notebook, a camera, and curious eyes.

items.question: Noor wrote down problems like ................
options: leaky taps and students leaving water running
items.answer: leaky taps and students leaving water running
items.explanation_ar: Noor كتبت مشاكل زي leaky taps يعني حنفيات بتنقّط وطلاب سايبين الميه شغالة.
items.explanation_en: Noor wrote down problems like leaky taps and students leaving water running.

items.question: Farida helped by making ................ posters.
items.explanation_ar: Farida عملت بوسترات bright and cheerful يعني ملونة ومبهجة.
items.explanation_en: Farida made bright and cheerful posters.

items.question: Mr. Youssef was the school ................
items.explanation_ar: حسب القصة، Mr. Youssef كان cleaner يعني عامل النظافة في المدرسة.
items.explanation_en: In the story Mr. Youssef was the school cleaner.

items.question: At the end, the head teacher gave the children ................
items.explanation_ar: في الآخر مدير المدرسة أدّى الأطفال certificates of achievement يعني شهادات تقدير.
items.explanation_en: At the end the head teacher gave the children certificates of achievement.

items.question: Using solar energy is good because it doesn't create ................
items.explanation_ar: الطاقة الشمسية كويسة لأنها مبتعملش pollution يعني تلوث.
items.explanation_en: Solar energy is good because it does not create pollution.

items.question: He is proud ................ his grandpa.
items.explanation_ar: بنقول proud of يعني فخور بـ.
items.explanation_en: We say proud of.

items.question: He ................ his friend last night.
items.explanation_ar: last night بتدل على الماضي، وماضي meet هو met.
items.explanation_en: Last night shows the past, and the past of meet is met.

items.question: They ................ the tomb of Tutankhamen in 1922.
items.explanation_ar: اكتشفوا discovered مقبرة توت عنخ آمون سنة 1922.
items.explanation_en: They discovered the tomb of Tutankhamen in 1922.

items.question: We use a ................ to cut vegetables.
items.explanation_ar: بنستخدم knife يعني سكينة علشان نقطع الخضار.
items.explanation_en: We use a knife to cut vegetables.

items.question: I play with my friends at the ................
items.explanation_ar: بنلعب مع أصحابنا في club يعني النادي.
items.explanation_en: I play with my friends at the club.

items.question: In Egypt, football ................ very popular and swimming is fun.
items.explanation_ar: football مفرد، فنستخدم is.
items.explanation_en: Football is singular, so we use is.

items.question: He ................ in the morning.
items.explanation_ar: He مفرد والجملة عادة كل صباح، فنستخدم drinks.
items.explanation_en: He is singular and the sentence is about a habit, so we use drinks.
